name: micro_topxs
description: 12 Binance-metrics majors, cross-sectional long/short against the coins where top accounts are most crowded long (30d z of top-trader L/S), 6h decisions, vol-targeted.
mechanism: Where the largest accounts have piled into longs relative to their own history, the marginal buyer is exhausted and the positioning must unwind; relative to other majors those coins underperform.
frozen_rule: config with the best MEDIAN within-fold train rank across walk-forward folds (tie: mean train Sharpe)

implementability_200.note: round_to_qty=True with load_bybit_instruments() on the stitched OOS weights; dropped share is an estimate (orders whose |delta notional| < max(minNotionalValue, minOrderQty*price) at the unrounded equity).

expectancy_units: USD per closed round trip on the $200 OOS account

causality.plus_walk_forward_guard: passed (walk_forward causality_checks=2 per fold raised nothing)

caveats: Top-trader ratio missing for most of 2022 -> no positions then; walk-forward training windows that fall in 2022 are empty.
Screen train-half t was 0.2-0.9: the gate passed on the test half only.
Live needs Binance public fapi topLongShortPositionRatio (Bybit has no top-trader ratio).
Verdict downgraded for fragility: a +/-1-step neighbour has negative dev Sharpe; dev Sharpe with 2x fees is 0.21
screen_evidence: XS FM partial t train/test 0.48/3.61 (6h), 0.19/3.11 (24h), 0.87/2.68 (72h); pooled TS version wrong sign.
bug_hunt: FROZEN is the raw rank (resid='none'), 72h overlapping hold.
OOS 2025H1 -10%; fees matter: 2x fees -> dev Sharpe 0.21 (from 0.51).
Random-timing 'runs' null ignored for the verdict (null turnover 1995x/yr vs 368x for the strategy).

notes: null_secondary ignored for the verdict: runs-null turnover 1995 vs strategy 368
verdict_inputs.fragility_downgrade: a +/-1-step neighbour has negative dev Sharpe; dev Sharpe with 2x fees is 0.21

verdict_rule:
Family-E verdict rule (applied identically to every module):
      p_used = the LARGER p-value of the two nulls, ignoring a random-timing 'runs' null whose
               mean turnover is > 1.5x the strategy's (the shuffled continuous weights then pay
               far more costs, which biases that null DOWN - see lab_bugs_found).
      promising: OOS Sharpe >= 0.8, p_used <= 0.05, deflated Sharpe (grid trials) >= 0.9 and
                 >= 60% of OOS calendar years positive.
      marginal : OOS Sharpe >= 0.5 and p_used <= 0.10.
      fails    : otherwise.
      Fragility downgrade (one level): any +/-1 grid-step neighbour of FROZEN with a negative
      dev Sharpe, or a dev Sharpe below 0.25 when fees are doubled (robustness_dev_frozen).
